about: How far a rep is towards a monthly Sales Target. What counts as achieved is decided once, on the server, by the manna_sales_targets Server Script (app/server/sales_targets.py): only lines SAP has invoiced, dated in the target's month. It returns invoiced_amount (line amount, before GST) and invoiced_kg. Both apps then turn that into the figure on screen with this rule — app/lib/core/sales_target.dart and client/src/domain/salesTarget.ts. A Tonnes target is measured in invoiced kg / 1000, a Currency target in invoiced amount. `fraction` is not capped: a rep past target reads over 100%, and only the bar is clamped. With no invoice in the month both apps still show achieved 0 and 0% against a target, and say no invoice has come yet.

cases.why: Half of a money target invoiced.
A tonnes target is measured in invoiced kilos, not money.
Past target reads past 100% — the number is not capped, only the bar is.
Nothing invoiced yet this month: achieved is 0 and so is the fraction, shown with a note that no invoice has come yet.
No target set: invoices still show, but there is no fraction of nothing.
An unknown or missing unit is money, as the doctype's default is.
